answer: Bindings are kept in haven, verified in atlas, and the chain is public. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 6 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the pulse check. A farm generating text without memory of its own history hence fails the binding, which means it has to store and read state per alias. Each duplicate costs another 132 dollars in locked collateral and another 3 days of waiting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
